sentences.en: He threw the bridle over the fence and strode up the pathway.
sentences.zh: 他把缰绳扔过栅栏，大步走上了小径。

sentences.en: Yanni was standing in the bathroom pathway.
sentences.zh: 雅尼站在浴室的小道上。

sentences.en: Most important of all, the brain needs global reentry pathways connecting these anatomical structures.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，大脑需要连接这些解剖结构的全局再进入通路。
